newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds higher but short of steam.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds higher but short of steam.

text.p: 1715 GMT - Bonds closed firmer but lacked the force of morning trade. However, with Treasuries firm, there could be upside on Thursday when eyes will be on U.S. data. *Sept 97 up nine at 111.30 vs Tuesday close *Feb 07 cash (OTC) 103.05 vs 102.80. Yld 6.18 vs 6.22 *Spread vs 10-yr cash Bund 69 bps vs 70 bps
